newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (2 OF 7).
newsitem.headline: TEXT OF ROMANIA FOREIGN INVESTMENT DECREE (2 OF 7).

text.p: (This is an unofficial translation of Romania's government Decree no.31/16.06.1997 on foreign investment. The unofficial translation was provided by Price Waterhouse Romania.
For any querries please contact Price Waterhouse at telephone +40-1 311-2455, fax +40-1 312-3334.)
CHAPTER TWO (of seven)
The Direct Foreign Capital Investment

Art. 6 (1) The machinery, installations, industrial equipment, transportation equipment, know-how, other goods which are subject to depreciation, and which are imported for the making and operation of the investment -- contributed in kind by the foreign investor to the share capital or purchased from a financing facility opened and guaranteed by the foreign investor in favour of the company, Romanian legal person and/or its subsidiaries, for the purpose of the operation and the performance of the investment in Romania -- benefit from the exemption from the payment of customs duties.

(2) The goods of a similar nature to those described in the preceding paragraph and which are purchased by the foreign investor from its dividends in order to increase the share capital of the company in question also benefit from exemption from the payment of customs duties.

(3) For the imported raw materials, consumables, spare parts and/or components, required for the own production purposes of the company, whose value is paid from the own sources of the said company or from sources attracted or borrowed from abroad, the company in question, Romanian legal person having full or partial foreign capital, benefits from the reduction by 50 percent of the customs duties for a period of two years from the date of commissioning of the foreign investment but no more than four years from the date of its registration with the Commerce Register.

Art.7 (1) Except for the goods representing contribution in kind, the incentives mentioned in Article 6 shall be granted only to companies established as Romanian legal entities in which the foreign capital contribution actually paid in cash is at least 20 percent of the registered capital, but no less than USD 350,000 or the equivalent thereof expressed in any other freely convertible currency and/or in lei.

(2) The profit tax which will be applicable to companies incorporated as Romanian legal persons with foreign participation, which satisfy the provisions of the preceding paragraph, shall be 15 percent for the first two years of activity, calculated from the date of commissioning of the project or from the date of effective commencement of activity, as the case may be, but no later than four years from the date of registration of the foreign investment with the Commerce Register.

Art.8 (1) Additional facilities shall be granted to foreign investments incorporated as Romanian legal entities, to which the foreign investor has effectively contributed in cash at least USD 5,000,000 or the equivalent thereof in any other freely convertible currency and/or in lei, as follows:
a. payment of a 15 percent tax applicable to the profits obtained from the activity conducted, for a period of five years, in addition to the period provided in Article 7, paragraph (2);

b. extension by three years of the period granted under the Article 6, paragraph (3) for the reduction by 50 percent of the customs duties applicable to the imported raw materials, consumables, spare parts and/or components, required for the own production of the investment, the countervalue of which is paid from own, attracted or foreign sources.
(2) The foreign investments shall benefit from the additional incentives listed in paragraph (1) subject to:
a. The value and field of investment;
b. Promotion of the export of the company's own products in a proportion of at least 40 percent;
c. Location of the investment in technological parks and/or economic zones declared by laws as special zones;
d. Development of the infrastructure;
e. Development of tourism;
f. Development of projects of social interest or meant to ensure environmental protection, as the case may be;
g. Annual reinvestment of at least 50 percent of the net profits obtained.
-- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
